summary: Sister Ebony (spell 8418) native: CountArmyColor@FirstLastEnemies Data 4 (Purple) before the damage, then CauseSpecificStatusEffectConditional barrier@Self UseCounterForAmount. No Condition reads the mana colours of the front and last enemies (at that step, before any kill); curated uses anyEnemyColor Purple, which also fires for a Purple enemy in the middle (default scenario E12) and misses nothing else. Proposal: Condition {kind:'positionColor', positions:['front','last'], color} (or a CountArmyColor counter source over a TargetMode) evaluated at segment time.
repro: castSpell({key:'troop:6937'}) -> 'status C +barrier' although E10 is Red and E13 Green/Brown; expected no Barrier. With enemies[3].colors=[Purple] and E12 not Purple, Barrier expected.
